bookingConfirmed.notes: Session message sent when the merchant confirms a 'pay in person' booking (shared/operations.js confirmBooking). English is the existing text, kept as the source.

bookingRescheduled.en: 📅 Your booking for *{service}* has been rescheduled to *{date} at {time}*. See you then! 🎉
bookingRescheduled.ar: 📅 تم تغيير موعد حجزك لخدمة *{service}* إلى *{date} الساعة {time}*. نراك في الموعد! 🎉
bookingRescheduled.notes: Session message sent after the merchant reschedules a booking (shared/operations.js rescheduleBooking).

bookingDeclined.en: We're sorry, we're unable to accommodate your request for *{service}* on *{date} at {time}*. Please pick another time — we'd love to see you!
bookingDeclined.ar: نعتذر، لا يمكننا تلبية طلبك لخدمة *{service}* بتاريخ *{date} الساعة {time}*. نرجو اختيار وقت آخر، وسيسعدنا استقبالك!
bookingDeclined.notes: Session message sent when the merchant declines a 'pay in person' booking request (shared/operations.js declineBooking).

bookingCancelled.en:
Hi {name}! 😔

Unfortunately your booking for *{service}* on *{slot}* has been cancelled.

We'd love to fit you in at another time — tap below to rebook at *no charge*!
bookingCancelled.ar:
أهلاً {name}! 😔

نأسف، تم إلغاء حجزك لخدمة *{service}* في *{slot}*.

يسعدنا استقبالك في وقت آخر. اضغط الزر أدناه لإعادة الحجز *مجاناً*!
bookingCancelled.notes: Interactive message sent when a booking is cancelled (utils/whatsapp.js sendRebookMessage, called by shared/operations.js cancelBooking). {slot} is the slot's date and time (or the slot fallback below).

bookingCancelledButton.notes: Rebook button of the cancelled-booking message. At most 20 characters (WhatsApp reply button).

slotFallback.notes: Stands in for {slot} when the booking has no time slot (same fallback as the English message).

orderSummary.notes: Order summary with the payment link (shared/operations.js createOrder). {items} is one line per item, amounts are written like 150.00 ر.س, the pay link carries ?lang=ar.

referralShare.en: Hi {name}👋 Share this link with a friend. They'll get {friend_reward}, and you'll earn {referrer_reward} when they buy: {link}
referralShare.ar: مرحباً {name} 👋 شارك هذا الرابط مع صديق. سيحصل صديقك على {friend_reward}، وستحصل أنت على {referrer_reward} عند شرائه: {link}
referralShare.notes: Referral link text (shared/referrals.js sendReferralLinksToCustomers). The reward phrases below fill {friend_reward} and {referrer_reward}; a merchant-typed reward label is used as written.

referralFriendFixed.notes: Friend reward of type fixed_discount (the English text shows the bare number).

referralFriendPoints.notes: Friend reward of type loyalty_points. Count-neutral wording: a counted noun after a number would be wrong for 1, 2 and 3-10 (GLOSSARY D10).

referralFriendOffer.notes: Friend reward without a type or label.

referralReferrerOffer.notes: Referrer reward without a type or label.

optOutHint.en: Reply STOP to stop promotional messages.
optOutHint.ar: لإيقاف الرسائل الترويجية أرسل «إلغاء الاشتراك» أو STOP
optOutHint.notes: Opt-out line appended to the Arabic referral link text. The English referral text has no such line; the Arabic one carries it so a marketing message always tells the customer how to stop it (compliance, spec 3.4). Owner's lawyer to approve.
